title: Resonance of Fate
next_chapter_hook: When that consciousness completely merged into his soul, Chen Ji finally understood—this was not merely a bloodline resonance, but a layout spanning ten thousand years; and the answer the Demonic Path commander had been waiting for was actually...

text.content:
Those eyes were exactly like his.

Chen Ji stood in the Void, surrounded by endless chaotic mist, and right before him, a figure with an identical face slowly turned around. The Twin of Fate—the true identity of the 49th chess piece—was now revealed. Not an enemy, not an ally, but a being sharing the same face and bloodline with him. "You've finally come." That voice seemed to echo from ancient times, carrying the vicissitudes of years and endless loneliness, "I have waited far too long."

Chen Ji said nothing, his pupils contracting sharply.

Because on that figure's brow center, a golden mark was slowly emerging—the pattern was almost identical to the Tianji Record Fragment hidden on his chest. "This is impossible..." His voice lost its composure for the first time. The Twin of Fate smiled faintly, a smile carrying inexplicable bitterness: "Nothing is impossible, Chen Ji. We were one, only... torn into two beings by Heavenly Will."

The aura of the Tianji Record violently trembled within him.

Chen Ji felt a intense vertigo, as if something was being forcibly extracted from the depths of his soul. He saw—within that chaotic mist, countless scenes flickered past like a parade: an ancient altar, twin infants torn apart by an invisible hand, one marked with the Tianji Record and the other thrown into the Demonic Path... "That is... our past." The Twin of Fate murmured softly, "The truth of ten thousand years ago."

dialogue.content: "Heavenly Will separated us to prevent the power of prophecy from gathering in one person." That figure's voice carried a hint of mockery, "Unfortunately, it overlooked one thing—the true bloodline connection cannot be severed by any power. So as your Tianji Record Fragment gradually becomes whole, our resonance grows stronger. This summons is my invitation to you."

text.content:
Chen Ji's fist slowly clenched.

He felt a violent force surging between them, the most primal call from the depths of their bloodline. The Twin of Fate stepped forward, closing the distance between them to mere inches. He could feel the other's heartbeat—perfectly synchronized with his own, disgustingly perfect. "What do you want?" Chen Ji's voice regained its composure, those deep eyes revealing no emotional fluctuation. The Twin of Fate extended his hand, palm upward: "I wish to merge with you. To make the prophecy complete again. Only this way can we truly escape Heavenly Will's control."

At this moment, a familiar remnant soul fluctuation emerged from the Tianji Record on Chen Ji's chest.

Mo Xiansheng's voice resonated in his soul, carrying unprecedented gravity: "Master, be careful. The Twin of Fate's words are half-truths. He does share blood with you, but his purpose is far from simple 'merging.' Before making a decision, you must understand one thing—the identity of the Demonic Path commander is his disguise. He had the Holy Sect use your sister to lead you down this path, all for this moment of reunion."

choice.prompt: The bloodline's call roars in your ears, the Twin of Fate awaits your answer

choices.description: The bloodline resonance is an irresistible ancient summons; accepting it may reveal more truths.
choices.visible_reward: Obtain Partial Memories of the Twin of Fate
choices.risk_hint: The Twin of Fate's words cannot be fully trusted; Mo Xiansheng warned that there must be something amiss

text.content: Just as Chen Ji's fingers were about to touch that figure, a violent torrent of consciousness surged into his soul. Countless images flooded in—ten thousand-year-old altar, torn twins, Heavenly Will's cold laughter, and... a deliberately hidden truth: the Twin of Fate never intended equal merger; he wanted to devour, to completely erase Chen Ji and monopolize the prophetic power. "You—" Chen Ji's expression changed dramatically, but that figure had already transformed into black light, drilling into the depths of his soul along his arm.

choices.description: Mo Xiansheng's warning still echoes; refuse this seemingly beautiful merger.
choices.visible_cost: Lose the Opportunity to Learn the Truth
choices.risk_hint: The Twin of Fate May Turn Hostile

text.content: Chen Ji's hand withdrew cleanly. The Twin of Fate's smile froze on his face, those identical eyes flashing disbelief. "You refuse?" The voice carried suppressed rage, "The bloodline's summons means nothing to you?" Chen Ji spoke calmly: "It means something. But I want to know why you're so desperate for me to accept. Mo Xiansheng said—things too easily obtained often have the highest price. Tell me, Demonic Path commander, am I wrong?" That figure's expression completely darkened.

choices.description: Neither actively accept nor directly refuse; first probe the other's hand and true intentions.
choices.visible_cost: Waste Time, May Miss the First Opportunity
choices.risk_hint: The other party may have detected your intentions

text.content: Chen Ji did not reach out his hand, nor did he retract it. He merely tilted his head slightly, examining the Twin Fates with a scrutinizing gaze. 'Before we discuss merging, I have a few questions.' His voice was terrifyingly calm. 'First, is the Demonic Path commander you mentioned actually your other identity? Second, what is your connection to my sister Chen Nian's disappearance? Third—' His eyes suddenly turned razor-sharp, 'Why did Heavenly Will separate us? Was it truly to prevent the prophetic power from concentrating, or was there another reason?' A crack finally appeared in the Twin Fates' expression.

Silence spread through the void. The Twin Fates' expression shifted through various emotions before transforming into a low sigh. 'Just as I anticipated, you never fall for tricks easily.' He waved his hand, and a blurry image emerged in the void—a young woman bound by chains, her features bearing a resemblance to Chen Ji, gazing desperately into the emptiness. 'Your sister Chen Nian is not only the Heavenly Fate Key, but also the last fragment of divine soul that scattered into the mortal world when we brothers were torn apart.' His voice was low. 'If she dies, we can never truly be complete. Does that count as having a connection?'

Chen Ji's pupils contracted sharply, and a terrifying murderous intent erupted from within him. Those chains, that imprisonment, that look of despair—it was Chen Nian, his sister! Sixteen years of searching, countless divinations, and she had been in the deepest depths of the Demonic Path all along! 'What have you done to her?' Chen Ji's voice was terrifyingly low, each word seemingly forced through his teeth. The Twin Fates spread his hands in an innocent gesture: 'Not me, it was those fools of the Holy Sect. However—' A meaningful smile curled at the corner of his lips. 'I can help you rescue her. In exchange, you only need to agree to one small request.'

dialogue.content: Chen Ji forcibly suppressed the fury in his heart, his voice cold: 'What request?' The Twin Fates stepped forward, closing the distance between them. He raised his hand and gently pressed it against Chen Ji's brow center, the touch ice-cold. 'Simple—when Heavenly Will tore us apart, it left a restriction within me. Whenever I attempt to approach the keeper of the Tianji Record, this restriction activates.' A flash of resentment flickered in his eyes. 'But if you willingly accept my consciousness entering your divine soul, this restriction won't be triggered. And I only need to rest within you for three years. After three years, I will automatically detach without harming you in the slightest.'

text.content: Chen Ji did not answer immediately. He rapidly calculated various possibilities in his heart. Mo Xiansheng's voice rang out again: 'Master, this person's words still have reservations. He says 'automatically detach,' but if he enters your divine soul, who knows if he might rewrite your will? However... what he said about Chen Nian is probably true. Because her existence interfered with the Tianji Record's foresight, I always thought it was a flaw. Now I realize—she is inherently part of you.' Chen Ji's eyes flickered slightly, a bolder plan taking shape in his heart. His gaze fell upon the Twin Fates once more, this time with more playfulness. 'Three years is too long. I'll give you three months. But I have conditions.'

choice.prompt: How will the Twin Fates react to Chen Ji's conditions?

choices.description: Use this opportunity to seek rescue for his sister while probing the other party's bottom line.
choices.visible_cost: Expose your care for Chen Nian
choices.visible_reward: May reach a more favorable agreement
choices.risk_hint: The Twin Fates may use this as leverage

text.content: The Twin Fates' brow furrowed slightly, clearly not expecting Chen Ji to negotiate with him. 'Let's hear them.' His tone carried more playfulness. Chen Ji raised three fingers: 'First, you must immediately give me a route map to the place where Chen Nian is imprisoned and the method to remove the restrictions. Second, during these three months, you shall not窥探 my memories or layouts in any way. Third—' A cold smile curled at the corner of his lips. 'If after three months I do not wish for you to stay, you must leave unconditionally. Otherwise, I will use the Tianji Record to destroy myself along with you.' The Twin Fates' expression finally changed.

choices.text: Demand to rescue the person first
choices.description: Rescue Chen Nian first, everything else is secondary. His sister's safety comes first.
choices.risk_hint: The Twin Fates may use this as leverage

text.content: 'My sister's matter is more important than anything else.' Chen Ji's voice brooked no argument. 'First have her stand safely before me, everything else can be negotiated.' The Twin Fates was silent for a moment, then let out a meaningful laugh: 'Good, very good. For ten thousand years, I've met someone this interesting for the first time.' He waved his hand, and a golden light shot into Chen Ji's brow center—a detailed map marking every guard and restriction in the Holy Sect forbidden grounds, along with the incantation to remove the chains from Chen Nian. 'This is my greatest sincerity. Now it's your turn.'

choices.description: Before making any decision, one must know the complete truth—including the true purpose of Heavenly Will.
choices.risk_hint: The other party may refuse to answer
choices.process_label: 你没有被条件打动，而是继续追问

text.content: 'Before discussing any deal,' Chen Ji's voice was terrifyingly calm, 'I want to know the entire truth. Why did Heavenly Will tear us apart? What is the true origin of the Tianji Record? What else have you done during these years lurking in the Demonic Path besides waiting for me?' The Twin Fates' expression finally grew solemn. He was silent for a long while before slowly speaking: 'What you ask is precisely what I least wish to mention.' He took a deep breath. 'Fine, since you want to know—Heavenly Will is not native to this world. It came from...' Suddenly, a thunderous bolt of lightning erupted in the void, striking directly at Chen Ji's crown! 'Damn it, it's listening!' The Twin Fates' face changed dramatically.

Chen Ji lunged backward, and the Tianji Record Fragment in his hand suddenly glowed, transforming into a golden barrier before him.

The thunder was terrifying beyond measure, carrying the power to destroy everything, yet it was barely blocked by the golden barrier. The Destiny Twin was also resisting, his body surrounded by rolling demonic energy, forming a standoff with the thunder. "This is the power of Heavenly Will!" His voice carried a hint of terror. "It has been watching us all along! The question just now violated some taboo—the truth of its origins must never be spoken!" Chen Ji's heart surged with torrential waves. Heavenly Will—coming from another world? What did that mean? Was this world, the cultivation realm, and the fate of all people merely chess pieces manipulated by an outsider?

The thunder gradually dissipated, but the dangerous aura permeating the void showed no sign of weakening.

The Destiny Twin gasped heavily, his gaze at Chen Ji gaining more complexity. "Do you understand now?" His voice was hoarse. "Why does Heavenly Will want to separate us? Why does it prevent anyone from probing into its origins? Because once the truth is known, its control will falter. It is not some heavenly way, but an... intruder who窃取了 this world's authority! The real reason we were torn apart is that we possess the possibility to overthrow it!" Chen Ji silently digested this information. His mind raced as countless fragments were piecing together a terrifying outline.

Suddenly, a familiar fluctuation came from the distance—that was the direction of Tianqing Sect. The Destiny Twin's expression slightly changed: "Someone is trying to locate your soul." He looked at Chen Ji. "Time is running out. You must make a decision—do you want me to enter your soul now, or..." Before he could finish, a crack suddenly appeared in the void, and a fair, jade-like hand reached out from the gap, directly grasping toward Chen Ji's brow center!

"Finally found you." A cold female voice sounded—it was Su Qingyao! She had actually tracked him here!

"Chen Ji!" Su Qingyao's voice carried suppressed worry. "How are you here? What kind of evil technique is this? Release him!"

The Destiny Twin coldly smiled, and a hint of displeasure flashed in those identical eyes to Chen Ji. "Another obstacle." He waved his hand, and a strand of black demonic energy swept toward Su Qingyao. Su Qingyao coldly snorted, her longsword leaving its sheath in her hand, sword light like a rainbow, directly dispersing that demonic energy. The two's auras collided in the void, evenly matched. "Who are you? Why are you impersonating Chen Ji?" Su Qingyao's eyes blazed with killing intent. "If I hadn't tracked the Tianji Record's aura on you all the way here, I wouldn't have known you dared to harm a Tianqing Sect disciple!"

Chen Ji stood in place, watching the scene before him, and an absurd feeling arose in his heart.

The Destiny Twin—his other half, an existence that intended to devour him; Su Qingyao—the woman who had been investigating him all along, now desperately trying to save him. The two were at sword's point, gunpowder filling the air. And he, the supposed "victim" to be "saved," stood here like a bystander. "Enough." Chen Ji finally spoke, his voice terrifyingly calm. "Senior Sister Su, he is not the enemy." Su Qingyao froze, looking at him incredulously: "What did you say? He is from the Demonic Path! He was clearly casting a spell on you just now!" Chen Ji shook his head, a bitter smile tugging at his lips: "He is me. Or rather, he is another me."

Su Qingyao's mind seemed to be struck by a heavy hammer, her entire body frozen in place.

"Another you?" Her voice trembled. "What are you talking about?" Chen Ji didn't explain, but turned to the Destiny Twin: "Regarding the deal from before, I have a new idea." His gaze moved between Su Qingyao and the Destiny Twin. "I don't need you to enter my soul. But I need you to do something for me—protect her." The Destiny Twin's eyes slightly narrowed. Su Qingyao was even more astonished: "Protect me? What are you saying—" Chen Ji raised his hand to interrupt her, continuing to speak to the Destiny Twin: "In three months, no matter what happens, she cannot die before me. In exchange, I will consider your previous proposal."

dialogue.content:
"Protect her?" The Destiny Twin examined Su Qingyao, a playful smile appearing at the corner of his lips. "For an outsider, you're willing to give up three months of soul-sharing rights?"

Chen Ji shook his head: "She is not an outsider." He looked at Su Qingyao, and a rare gentleness flickered in those deep eyes. "She is the only person in Tianqing Sect who has been investigating me from beginning to end. Even though she knows my schemes are terrifying, even though she could become my enemy at any moment, she still chose to stand on my side. This kind of person—" His voice slightly paused. "Is worth six months of uncertainty to exchange for." Su Qingyao's hand trembled slightly; she had never imagined that this seemingly worthless junior brother would say such words.

text.content:
The Destiny Twin fell silent for a long time.

His gaze moved between Chen Ji and Su Qingyao, seemingly evaluating something. Finally, he let out a meaningful laugh: "Very well. I agree." His form began to fade. "In three months, I will come for you. At that time, you must give me an answer—whether to merge into one, or..." He didn't finish, but the cold light flashing in those eyes explained everything. "As for her—" He glanced at Su Qingyao one last time. "I will have the Demonic Path stop pursuing her. But only if she doesn't actively provoke my subordinates." As his words fell, his figure completely vanished into the void.

The chaotic mist around also began to dissipate, light gradually growing bright. Su Qingyao looked at this familiar yet strange junior brother before her, her heart filled with countless emotions. "Chen Ji... who exactly are you?" Her voice was very soft, as if afraid to awaken something.

Chen Ji turned around, meeting those questioning eyes. He didn't answer, only offering a slight smile—that smile carried a hint of exhaustion, a hint of relief, and an indefinable tenderness. "Let's go, Senior Sister Su. Some things... I will tell you later." His voice was light, yet it stirred layered ripples in Su Qingyao's heart.

The Tianji Record on his chest slightly warmed, and Mo Xiansheng's voice rang in his soul: "Master, you made a very risky decision. However—" He paused. "Perhaps this is precisely the key to breaking the chess game. Your blood resonance with the Destiny Twin has already been activated. No matter what happens in the future, you are no longer alone. And Su Qingyao... her appearance will likely make the upcoming layout more complicated, but also... more spectacular."

Chen Ji said nothing, only raising his head to gaze toward the horizon.

There, the clouds churned, as if something was watching over this land.

The Eye of Heavenly Way.

It had never left.

And now, it must have already sensed—its chess piece had begun to resist.

The next storm was coming.

choice.prompt: Only you and Su Qingyao remain in the void, her questioning is right before you.

choices.description: Since it has already been exposed, might as well give her an account, maintaining fragile trust.
choices.risk_hint: How much to say? What to say? The measure is difficult to gauge.
choices.process_label: 你决定告诉她一部分真相

text.content: Chen Ji took a deep breath, making a move that surprised Su Qingyao—he reached out and gently grasped her hand. The touch was warm and real, causing Su Qingyao to stiffen all over. "Senior Sister Su, there are some things I still cannot say completely." His voice was soft. "But I can tell you one thing." He leaned close to her ear, breath carrying faint warmth. "Someone in Tianqing Sect wants to kill me. Former Sect Master Ling Yuan... is not as kind as he appears on the surface. You—be careful of him." As his words fell, he released her hand and turned to fly toward Tianqing Sect, leaving Su Qingyao standing alone, her heart in turmoil.

choices.description: The truth is too shocking; revealing it now would only further chaos the situation.

text.content: "Senior Sister Su, the less you know about certain things, the safer you are." Chen Ji's voice returned to its usualplain, those eyes becoming like a still deep well. "You only need to know—I have never done anything to betray Tianqing Sect. As for the rest..." He turned around, back facing her. "Consider it I owe you a favor." Su Qingyao bit her lip tightly, anger and anxiety warring in her heart. This man had already exposed so much, yet he was still evading her questions. "Chen Ji!" She called out to stop him. "Do you regard me as someone who can be trusted?" Chen Ji's footsteps paused, but he didn't turn around: "Precisely because I regard you as such, I cannot let you get involved even more. Go back, Senior Sister Su. From now on..." His voice drifted in the wind. "Stop investigating me."

choices.description: Before revealing more, first confirm whether she truly stands on your side.
choices.visible_cost: May make her heart grow cold.
choices.process_label: 你停下脚步，说出了一句让她shocked的话

text.content: "Chen Ji stopped in his tracks and slowly turned around. His gaze fell upon Su Qingyao, those eyes so profound it was as if they could see through everything. 'Senior Sister Su, you've been chasing me for so long, you must be eager to catch me with something incriminating, right?' A meaningful smile curved the corner of his lips. 'If I told you now that I hold evidence against the old Sect Master—the kind that could utterly disgrace and ruin him—what would you do?' Su Qingyao's expression shifted subtly. Chen Ji continued: 'Help me, and you become a traitor; don't help me, and you'll never know the truth.' He spread his arms wide, adopting an innocent posture, 'This is the truth you wanted to know, Senior Sister Su. Ugly, isn't it?'"

"When that consciousness completely merged with his soul, Chen Ji finally understood—this was not merely a resonance of bloodline, but an arrangement spanning ten thousand years; and the answer that the Demonic Path Commander had been waiting for was actually..."

"The light in the Void grew increasingly brighter, and Chen Ji felt his consciousness being forcibly pulled back to reality.

The Twin Destinies had vanished, but the information they left behind was seared into the depths of Chen Ji's soul like a brand—regarding the origin of the Will of Heavenly Dao, regarding the true origins of the Tianji Record, regarding the truth of how his two brothers were torn apart. Everything pointed toward a chilling possibility. Mo Xiansheng's voice rang out once more, carrying unprecedented gravity: 'Master, you must grow stronger as quickly as possible. The Will of Heavenly Dao has already sensed the abnormality. From this moment on, every move you make will be watched. Three months... perhaps that is our final opportunity.'

Chen Ji did not respond.

He simply stood quietly in the Void, allowing those staggering truths to surge through his mind. The Will of Heavenly Dao was an invader, the Tianji Record was its chess piece, and he himself—merely an awakened piece in this chess game that had begun ten thousand years ago.

But pieces have their uses too.

A cold smile slowly curved the corner of his lips, his eyes blazing with dangerous light.

Since you treat me as a piece, then I shall be the one—the piece that bites back."
